title: CFPC Elaborate Contract
description: Composition layer over existing CFPC machinery. Declares elaboration modes dispatched uniformly through the intent resolver. Not an independent execution arm.

@id.description: Unique identifier for this elaborate contract.

@owner.description: Owning micronaut id. Used as the caller in sub-invocations.

@intent.description: Intent label applied to all mode dispatches.

items.description: Elaboration operation label. 'elaborate' is not permitted (recursive elaborate guard).

@modes.description: Elaboration modes. Each mode produces one sub-query dispatched uniformly through the resolver.

@captures.description: Fields or aspects to retain from elaboration findings.

@backend.description: Backend capability used for all mode dispatches.

@policy.description: Policy block. promote_generated_facts=true and allow_weight_updates=true are both rejected at parse time (Pattern Induction Guards).

max_depth.description: Maximum invocation depth per mode dispatch. Default 3.

max_operations.description: Maximum number of modes processed. Default 6.

cycle_detection.description: Enable cycle detection in sub-invocations. Default true.

promote_generated_facts.description: MUST NOT be true. Rejected by Pattern Induction Guard 1.

allow_weight_updates.description: MUST NOT be true. Rejected by Pattern Induction Guard 2.
